extDescription.message: Manage your physical card stock from your Moxfield collection: marking a deck as built takes its cards out of the stock.

stockHint.message: “Free” = available outside built decks. Click a card that is in decks to see which ones.

historyHint.message: Actions on the stock and built decks, most recent first.

collectionHint.message: Fetched from your Moxfield account (you just need to be signed in to it in this browser), even with Moxfield closed. It is the reference for the stock: to fix a quantity, edit your collection on Moxfield.

collectionAuto.message: Fetch automatically (after each change on Moxfield, and every hour)

csvHint.message: Fallback if the automatic fetch fails. On Moxfield: collection → Export → CSV. Importing again updates the stock without losing built decks.

syncOffHint.message: Automatic backup to a private folder in your Drive, synced between your computers. Only needed once per computer. If the popup closes during Google authorization, open it again.

syncAccountKeepLocal.message: Send this computer's stock to the new account

syncAccountChangedHint.message: The replaced version stays in the history. Switching back to the old account resumes the sync.

errorReportsHint.message: When the extension hits an error, an anonymous report is sent to the developer so it can be fixed: error message, extension version, browser and system. Never your stock, your decks or your email address.

dangerHint.message: Completely empties the stock and unbuilds every deck marked as physically built.

deckPageChanged.message: The list changed on Moxfield since the deck was built: $1 — seen on $2. Open the deck to update the build.

stockEmpty.message: No cards in stock — import your collection above.

stockMoreRows_one.message: … and $1 more card: narrow it down with the filter.

stockMoreRows_other.message: … and $1 more cards: narrow it down with the filter.

collectionUncovered_one.message: Your collection no longer covers $1 card from built decks:

collectionUncovered_other.message: Your collection no longer covers $1 cards from built decks:

syncChoiceNotice.message: Drive already holds data (changed on $1) and this computer has a stock too. Which one should be kept? The other version will stay in the history.

syncSwitchAccountWeb.message: To switch accounts: Disconnect, then Connect Google Drive with the other account.

syncSwitchAccountProfile.message: To switch accounts, change the Chrome profile's account: the extension will ask you what to do.

snapshotConflict.message: version set aside during a conflict

snapshotsNone.message: No versions in the history yet.

snapshotRestoreConfirm.message: Replace the stock and built decks with the version from $1? It will also be applied to your other computers.

syncAccountKeepRemoteConfirm.message: Replace this computer's stock with the new account's? (if it has none, this computer's stock will be sent to it)

syncDisconnectConfirm.message: Stop syncing on this computer? The data stays on this computer and on Drive.

resetSyncWarning.message: Sync is on: your other computers will be emptied too.

resetConfirm.message: Reset the whole stock and all built decks?

errorReportsNotConfigured.message: No report service is set up in this version: nothing is sent.

historyDeckBuilt_one.message: Deck “$2” built: $1 card taken out of the free stock

historyDeckBuilt_other.message: Deck “$2” built: $1 cards taken out of the free stock

historyDeckUnbuilt_one.message: Deck “$2” unbuilt: $1 card returned to the stock

historyDeckUnbuilt_other.message: Deck “$2” unbuilt: $1 cards returned to the stock

blockingVersionTaken_one.message: $1 whose printing is already in another deck

blockingVersionTaken_other.message: $1 whose printing is already in another deck

availabilityVersionTaken.message: printing already used by another built deck: $1

versionWarningTitle_one.message: Printing already used by another built deck ($1 card)

versionWarningTitle_other.message: Printing already used by another built deck ($1 cards)

versionWarningHint.message: build blocked, pick on Moxfield a printing you still own, or unbuild the other deck:

buildBlockedVersionTaken.message: Can't build — printing already used by another built deck for: $1

availabilityCount.message: $1/$2 cards available in the free stock, excluding basic lands

moxfieldSessionExpired.message: Moxfield session expired: sign in again on moxfield.com in this browser.

moxfieldBlocked.message: Moxfield refused the fetch (code $1). Try again later, or use the CSV import.

moxfieldUnexpected.message: Unexpected response from Moxfield (step “$1”, $2): the way it works may have changed. Use the CSV import in the meantime.

moxfieldNoSession.message: No Moxfield session: sign in on moxfield.com in this browser.

moxfieldDeckUnavailable.message: Deck not found or private on Moxfield.

googleAccountReadError.message: Google Drive answered $1 when reading the account.

googleWindowFailed.message: The Google sign-in window could not complete.

googleBraveHint.message: In Brave, turn on “Allow Google login for extensions” (brave://settings/extensions), then try again.

csvColumnsMissing.message: 'Count' / 'Name' columns not found in the CSV — unexpected format.

deckNoLongerBuilt.message: This deck is no longer marked as built.

backupNotOurs.message: This file is not a Moxfield Stock Manager backup.

backupMissingParts.message: Corrupted backup: stock or built decks missing.

driveUnreachable.message: Google Drive is unreachable: check your connection.

driveUnavailable.message: Google Drive is temporarily unavailable ($1): try again in a few minutes.

extensionReloaded.message: The extension was reloaded in the meantime — refresh this page (F5) and try again.

printingWarningTitle_one.message: In your collection but not in the right printing for this deck ($1 card)

printingWarningTitle_other.message: In your collection but not in the right printing for this deck ($1 cards)

printingWarningHint.message: build blocked, fix or remove these lines before confirming:

shortagePricePartial_one.message: Cost of the missing cards: at least $2 ($1 card without a price)

shortagePricePartial_other.message: Cost of the missing cards: at least $2 ($1 cards without a price)

shortagePriceSource.message: Cardmarket price of the deck's printing (the cheapest one if it uses several), as given by Moxfield.

cardmarketCopyButton.message: Copy the missing cards for Cardmarket

clipboardCopyFailed.message: Could not copy the list to the clipboard.

cardmarketCopied_one.message: $1 card copied — on Cardmarket, open a wants list, add a deck list and paste.

cardmarketCopied_other.message: $1 cards copied — on Cardmarket, open a wants list, add a deck list and paste.

cardCountMismatch.message: $1 — ⚠️ the site shows $2: check the list before confirming

pageNoCards.message: no cards detected on the page.

pageTotalNotFound.message: $1, but the total shown by Moxfield (“N main deck”) was not found.

deckCannotCheck.message: Could not check whether the list changed since the deck was built: $1

deckSuspectSummary_one.message: See what was detected ($1 difference from the build)

deckSuspectSummary_other.message: See what was detected ($1 differences from the build)

deckUnchanged.message: The list hasn't changed since the deck was built ($1).

deckChangedTitle.message: The list changed on Moxfield since the deck was built ($1):

deckUpdateHint.message: “$1” adjusts the stock for these cards only.

deckUpdateBlocked.message: Not enough stock, different printing or printing already used: fix it first (see above).

overlayTitleBuild.message: Mark this deck as physically built

overlayBuiltIntro.message: This deck is currently marked as built. Unbuilding it returns the cards it uses to the stock.

overlayIntro.message: List detected automatically from the page — check/fix it before confirming (one card per line, "QTY Name"). If it is empty or incomplete, click Moxfield's “Copy” button, then “$1”.

buttonBuiltOutdated.message: Physically built — the list changed since the deck was built (click to update)

clipboardEmpty.message: Clipboard empty or format not recognized — paste manually with Ctrl+V.

updateBlocked.message: Can't update — not enough stock, different printing or printing already used.

updateDone.message: Build updated, stock adjusted for the changed cards.

noCardsRecognized.message: No cards recognized in the list — check the format (QTY Name).

buildBlockedWrongEdition.message: Can't build — different printing from your collection for: $1

unbuildDone.message: Deck unbuilt, cards returned to the stock.

buildDone.message: Deck marked as built, cards taken out of the stock.

proxiesHint.message: The missing copies are played as proxies: they are not taken from your stock, and you can print them.

buildDoneWithProxies_one.message: Deck built with $1 proxy — print it from the popup or this window.

buildDoneWithProxies_other.message: Deck built with $1 proxies — print them from the popup or this window.

replaceProxiesHint.message: You now have the real card in your free stock: it will replace the proxy and be taken from the stock. $1

proxiesReplaced_one.message: $1 proxy replaced by the real card.

proxiesReplaced_other.message: $1 proxies replaced by the real card.

proxiesNothingToReplace.message: No proxy to replace: the real card is not (or no longer) in your free stock.

historyProxiesReplaced_one.message: Deck “$2”: $1 proxy replaced by the real card, taken from the free stock

historyProxiesReplaced_other.message: Deck “$2”: $1 proxies replaced by the real card, taken from the free stock

proxiesPrintHint.message: Print at 100% (actual size), without fitting to the page. A double-faced card takes two slots: front and back, to slide back to back into the same sleeve.

proxiesCredits.message: Card images: Scryfall. Cards and artwork © Wizards of the Coast. For your personal use only.

proxiesNone.message: This deck is no longer built, or has no proxies.

proxiesLoading.message: Looking up the images on Scryfall…

proxiesSomeMissing.message: $1 Image not found for $2 slot(s): the card name is printed instead.

proxiesScryfallError.message: Scryfall can't be reached right now: only the card names are shown. Try again later (reload the page).

moxfieldNotEditions.message: the response doesn't contain the card's printings

moxfieldEditionNotSaved.message: Moxfield didn't save the requested printing

ownedEditionsHint.message: Switches these cards, in your Moxfield deck, to a printing from your collection (preferably one no other built deck uses), then reloads the page. The deck is not built. Cards with no other owned printing stay as they are.

ownedEditionsLoading.message: Looking up your printings (Moxfield collection and deck)…

ownedEditionsDone_one.message: $1 card switched to the printing in your collection.

ownedEditionsDone_other.message: $1 cards switched to the printing in your collection.

ownedEditionsSkipNotInDeck.message: not found in the Moxfield deck

ownedEditionsSkipSeveral.message: several printings on the same deck line, to change by hand

ownedEditionsSkipNoOther.message: no other printing in your collection

ownedEditionsSkipUnknown.message: the printing in your collection can't be found on Moxfield

ownedEditionsSkipChanged.message: changed on Moxfield in the meantime, left untouched

ownedEditionsZero.message: No card could be switched to a printing from your collection.

ownedEditionsProgressHint.message: Don't close this tab or edit the deck in the meantime.

ownedEditionsSkipNotEnough.message: not enough copies in a single printing of your collection for the whole deck line

ownedEditionsSkipTaken.message: your copies of the owned printings are already in other built decks

buttonBuiltWithProxies_one.message: Physically built with $1 proxy (click to unbuild)

buttonBuiltWithProxies_other.message: Physically built with $1 proxies (click to unbuild)

syncBackupHint.message: The backup is in a hidden folder of your Drive, reserved for the extension: it doesn't show up in your files, only in Drive → Settings → Manage apps.

updateTitle.message: New version of the extension available

updateSummary_one.message: $1 change on GitHub since your version:

updateSummary_other.message: $1 changes on GitHub since your version:

updateHowTo.message: To install it: git pull in the extension's folder, then reload it in chrome://extensions and refresh your Moxfield tabs.

updateBadgeTitle.message: Moxfield Stock Manager — new version available

onboardingCollectionText.message: The stock starts from your Moxfield collection: it tells which cards you own. Sign in to Moxfield in this browser, then fetch it. After that, it updates by itself.

onboardingButtonsTitle.message: Find the buttons on a deck page

onboardingButtonsText.message: Open one of your decks on Moxfield: the extension adds its buttons there, at the bottom left of the page (or in Moxfield's action bar when it is shown).

onboardingLegendBuild.message: Open box: the deck is not built. Click it to build the deck.

onboardingLegendOk.message: on the box: every card is in your free stock, the deck can be built.

onboardingLegendBlocked.message: on the box: number of cards blocking the build (missing, or owned in another printing). Hover the button for details.

onboardingLegendBuilt.message: Green check circle: the deck is built. Click it to unbuild or update it.

onboardingLegendEditions.message: Arrows: switch the deck to the printings you own.

onboardingBuildText.message: On the deck page, click the open box, check the detected list, then confirm. The deck's cards leave your free stock; unbuild the deck to put them back. If cards are missing, the window tells which built deck holds them and their price.

onboardingMoreSync.message: Google Drive sync (further down): automatic backup, and the same stock on all your computers.

onboardingMoreHistory.message: History: every build, unbuild and collection change.

onboardingMoreProxies.message: Proxies: build a deck despite missing cards, and print them.

onboardingMoreReplay.message: This guide stays available at the bottom of the popup.

decksHint.message: The decks you keep with the heart ♥ (bottom left of a Moxfield deck page), along with built decks: see at a glance what you can build with your free stock. You can also paste a deck's address.

decksNone.message: No decks yet: click the heart ♥ of a deck on Moxfield, or paste its address above.

decksInvalidUrl.message: Moxfield deck address not recognized (e.g. https://moxfield.com/decks/…).

likeAdd.message: Keep this deck in “My decks” (extension popup), to build it later

declaredProxiesNotice_one.message: $1 proxy declared on Moxfield, built without taking a card from the stock: $2

declaredProxiesNotice_other.message: $1 proxies declared on Moxfield, built without taking a card from the stock: $2
